Bash(/tmp/search_xml.ps1 << 'PSEOF'
$xmlPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.nuget\\packages\\mudblazor\\9.0.0-preview.2\\lib\\net9.0\\MudBlazor.xml"
$lines = Get-Content $xmlPath | Where-Object { $_ -match 'Palette' } | Select-Object -First 80
foreach \($line in $lines\) {
    Write-Output $line.Trim\(\)
}
PSEOF)

Bash(/tmp/strings_palette.ps1 << 'PSEOF'
$dllPath = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.nuget\\packages\\mudblazor\\9.0.0-preview.2\\lib\\net9.0\\MudBlazor.dll"
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($dllPath\)
$text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString\($bytes\)
$matches = [regex]::Matches\($text, '[A-Za-z\\.]+Palette[A-Za-z]*'\)
$unique = $matches | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Sort-Object -Unique
foreach \($m in $unique\) {
    Write-Output $m
}
PSEOF)
